title: Next-generation template editor
context: Postmark's next-generation template editor, a 10-month initiative that needed cross-functional alignment from the start.
role: Spearheaded the initiative: technical discovery, cross-functional alignment and executive communication.
result: Carried the initiative through its full lifecycle, from concept to delivery.

title: Multi-agent framework for AI coding agents
context: AI coding agents needed guardrails, cost control and grounding in current vendor documentation to be useful on production work.
role: Designed and built a multi-agent framework with human-in-the-loop write gates and risk-based model routing, plus an agentic RAG documentation-search MCP server.
result: Agents stayed grounded in current vendor docs, and personal delivery throughput increased roughly 10x.

title: Customer Support tooling
context: The L2 Customer Support team depended on engineering escalations and a legacy PHP support console.
role: Built internal tooling so L2 could resolve issues without escalating, and rebuilt the console as a React and TypeScript micro frontend with full feature parity.
result: Contributed to cutting average first reply time from 6 hours to 23 minutes and escalated-ticket resolution from over 17 days to under 7. The new console halved initial load time and made in-app actions 2 times faster.

title: Support console testing strategy
context: A new React frontend for the support console with no testing baseline.
role: Established the unit testing baseline with Jest and React Testing Library, and architected the Playwright end-to-end strategy: modular environment configuration, reusable fixtures and page objects, and parallel execution.
result: Coverage of 95–97% across the three modules, and team adoption driven through documentation and a knowledge-share session.

title: Legacy platform modernization
context: A legacy Rails 4 and jQuery monolith whose data tables took over 20 seconds to load.
role: Spearheaded the move to a Rails 6 API with a React frontend and rebuilt the data table architecture: no more N+1 queries, refined indexing and caching.
result: Load times dropped from over 20 seconds to under 8.

title: GDPR consent enforcement
context: Compliance and data privacy requirements on Blue Apron's e-commerce web platform, alongside its migration from Braze to Segment for customer data collection.
role: Designed the consent preferences in OneTrust and Google Tag Manager, and worked on the Segment migration within the Rails backend and React frontend.
result: User consent preferences are enforced through the stack, ensuring GDPR compliance.
